payload.name: Mortgage Industry Regulations
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
C4C: Mortgage Industry Regulations gives ChatGPT the actual text of U.S. mortgage regulations and agency guides: HUD Handbook 4000.1, the Fannie Mae Selling and Servicing Guides, the Freddie Mac Guide, the Ginnie Mae MBS Guide, the VA Lenders Handbook (M26-7) and USDA HB-1-3555, plus the CFR and U.S. Code sections they rest on.

Ask a question the way you'd ask a colleague, in plain words or loan-file shorthand like "DTI" or "RSU income". ChatGPT finds the governing section, quotes it verbatim, and gives you the citation, the effective date and the dated source document it came from. It flags when a rule has two versions in force, a pending revision, or was changed by a later letter. It can also look up a citation you already have (B3-4.3-04, 4000.1 II.A.4.c, 12 CFR 1026.43) and check whether a passage, including one from your own draft, really appears in the regulator's text.

Four guided worflows: FHA, VA and USDA loan-file QC, and a review against Fannie Mae's AI Lender Letter LL-2026-04. Each check comes back with the rule it rests on, and your documents stay in your chat.

Read-only, with no sign-in or account. Questions outside mortgage regulation get "not found" rather than a stretch. Results are for research and are not legal advice: verify against the primary source.
payload.longDescription:
C4C：抵押贷款法规功能为ChatGPT提供了美国抵押贷款法规和监管机构指南的原文，包括《HUD手册4000.1》、房利美《销售与服务指南》、房地美指南、吉利美MBS指南、VA贷款商手册（M26-7）和农业部HB-1-3555手册，以及它们所依据的《联邦法规》和《美国法典》条款。

您可以像向同事提问一样用日常语言，或使用贷款文件缩写（如"DTI"或"RSU收入"）提问。ChatGPT会查找相关条款，逐字引用并提供引用信息、生效日期以及原始来源文件的日期。当某项规定存在两个现行版本、 pending修订或被后续信函修改时，系统会特别标注。您也可以查询已有引用信息（如B3-4.3-04、4000.1 II.A.4.c、12 CFR 1026.43），并验证某段内容（包括您自己起草的文本）是否确实出现在监管机构原文中。

包含四个引导流程：FHA、VA和农业部贷款文件质量检查，以及针对房利美AI贷款信LL-2026-04的审查。每次检查结果都会显示对应的规定条款，且您的文件会保留在聊天记录中。

仅限只读模式，无需登录或账户。超出抵押贷款法规范围的问题将返回"未找到"而非猜测性回答。结果仅供研究参考，不构成法律建议，请以官方原文为准。

payload.name: CoverForce
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CoverForce gives licensed agents, retail agencies, wholesalers and MGAs real-time commercial insurance quotes from 60+ carrier products. Describe a risk in plain language and CoverForce builds the submission, asks only the underwriting questions that carrier actually needs, and returns bindable quotes side by side. Coverage includes Workers' Comp, BOP, GL, Cyber, MPL, and more. When you're ready to bind, you complete the application on CoverForce's secure platform or directly with the selected carrier.

CoverForce is technology infrastructure, not an insurance agency. Every quote runs under your own agency's carrier appointments: CoverForce verifies your broker codes with each carrier at setup, then submits through that carrier's live API. Agents in a wholesaler or network program can also quote under a partner's appointments where that access has been granted. More than $1.2 billion in premium has been quoted through the platform, across 50,000+ submissions a month.

CoverForce is available to U.S.-based insurance professionals only. You need an active property & casualty license in the states you quote, and an agency with a verified CoverForce account and active carrier appointments — register at coverforce.com. You'll only see carriers, products and states your agency is appointed and licensed for. Quotes are indicative until a carrier confirms and binds them, and remain subject to carrier underwriting and appetite. Policy issuance, servicing and all claims are handled directly by the issuing carrier.

By chatting with us through ChatGPT, the information you provide in this chat will be subject to ChatGPT's Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, and may be shared with CoverForce, your agency, participating insurance carriers and service providers for the purpose of providing you with insurance quotes. Please only share the business information needed to quote the risk, and no additional sensitive information. To learn more about how CoverForce processes your information, see our privacy policy at www.coverforce.com .

payload.name: Moody's Struct & Pvt Cashflows
payload.description: 生成结构化与私人现金流
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Moody’s Structured and Private Cashflows MCP powers AI applications with a Gen AI accessible integration allowing for the calculation of cashflows and the calculation of subsequent tranche prices. 

This innovative users to efficiently run, validate, and analyze cashflows using natural language, across Moody’s structured finance deal libraries, with coverage spanning CLO/CDO, RMBS, CMBS, ABS, Agency, Esoteric, and Private Credit. By leveraging Structured and Private Cashflows, users can perform cashflow analysis easily by prompting queries, and receive the entire suite of Deal, Tranche, Collateral, Account, and Fee related cashflows. 

As AI-generated and client-defined deals evolve, the Structured and Private Cashflows serves as the common layer, delivering: 

- Centralized cashflow execution: Run cash flows across Moody’s structured finance deal libraries today, with support for AI generated deals as workflows evolve 

- Model and cashflow integrity: Powered by Moody’s proven cash flow and waterfall engines designated to support mathematical integrity, traceability, and transparent review 

- Comprehensive analytics: Supports pricing, multi-scope cashflow views, first-loss analysis, stratifications, and incremental analytics on existing cashflows. 

- Flexible outputs: Delivers structured cash flow results directly into visualizations, investor reporting, downstream analytics, and client-owned templates and systems
payload.longDescription:
穆迪结构化与私人现金流MCP通过生成式人工智能可访问的集成方式，支持现金流计算及后续各档价格计算的AI应用。

这项创新功能使用户能够通过自然语言，高效运行、验证和分析现金流，覆盖穆迪结构化金融交易库中的各类产品，包括CLO/CDO、RMBS、CMBS、ABS、代理证券、特殊资产和私人信贷。
通过使用结构化与私人现金流功能，用户可通过提示查询轻松进行现金流分析，并获取完整的交易、档位、抵押品、账户及费用相关现金流信息。

随着AI生成和客户定义的交易不断发展，结构化与私人现金流作为统一基础层，提供以下能力：

- 集中式现金流执行：如今即可在穆迪结构化金融交易库中运行现金流，并随着工作流演进支持AI生成的交易

- 模型与现金流完整性：依托穆迪经过验证的现金流和偿付顺序引擎，确保数学准确性、可追溯性和透明化审查

- 全面分析功能：支持定价、多维度现金流视图、首损分析、分层结构以及对现有现金流的增量分析

- 灵活输出形式：将结构化现金流结果直接输出至可视化图表、投资者报告、下游分析以及客户自有的模板和系统

payload.name: The Coin Daily
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Coin Daily is a daily crypto news publication. This connector exposes its Research desk to your assistant: focused price charts with replay and A/B selection; funding, open interest, liquidations and order-book readings on the API's own observation clocks; hourly market-regime and volatility context; governed group comparisons (for example decentralised-finance versus AI-related crypto projects); source-linked news and video timelines; and the latest published Market Update with its chapters. Fourteen data tools retrieve evidence and fourteen focused widgets display it — widgets never invent values and missing readings stay gaps. There is no trading, order placement, wallet or payment action, and outputs are editorial market commentary, not personalised investment advice; the one preparation tool starts a bounded server-side computation and writes nothing of yours. A current membership (or trial/complimentary access) is required; sign-in uses OAuth 2.1 through the connector.
payload.longDescription: The Coin Daily 是一份每日加密货币新闻出版物。该连接器将研究台功能开放给您的助手：包含回放和A/B选择功能的聚焦价格图表；通过API自带的观察时钟展示资金费率、未平仓合约、清算和订单簿读数；每小时更新的市场状态和波动率背景；受控组比较（例如去中心化金融与人工智能相关加密项目）；关联原始来源的新闻和视频时间线；以及最新发布的《市场更新》报告及其章节内容。十四种数据工具收集证据，十四种聚焦小部件展示数据——小部件不会虚构数值，缺失数据时段会保留空白。该工具不提供交易、下单、钱包或支付功能，输出内容为编辑制作的市场评论而非个性化投资建议；唯一的一个准备工具仅启动有限的服务器端计算，并不会保存您的任何数据。需要当前会员资格（或试用/免费访问权限）；登录功能通过连接器使用OAuth 2.1协议。

payload.name: Insourcia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Insourcia gives your assistant direct access to French company data: 30 million registered entities, 17 million of them active, with 32 million director mandates, 7 million filed annual accounts and 20 million legal events.

The connector covers five things.

Discovery. Search in natural language on sector, geography, size, directors or financial aggregates (revenue, EBITDA, debt, cash, whether a fund sits on the cap table). Match a CRM export or a spreadsheet to the right SIREN numbers in bulk; the tool declines to guess when the identification is ambiguous rather than returning a plausible wrong answer.

Profile. Identity, activity, headcount, directors, industry codes for a single company in one call, plus a directed map of its group: holdings, subsidiaries, sister companies, shared directors.

Financials. Income statement, balance sheet and ratios across consecutive fiscal years (cash, net debt, working capital, margins, payment terms, dividends). Credit risk grade from AAA to D with default probability at 3, 6 and 12 months and the main contributing factors.

Legal monitoring. Business transfers, insolvency proceedings, account filings, capital increases, public procurement awards, subsidies, strike-offs and incorporations, searchable across all companies or as a timeline for one.

Watchlists. Save a search or put a company under watch from the conversation, then read back what changed and mark signals as handled. These objects are the same ones the Insourcia web app uses: whatever your assistant saves, you find in your account.

Data comes from the French public registries (INPI/RNE, INSEE, BODACC, DECP) and sector sources, consolidated and reconciled by us. An Insourcia account is required
payload.longDescription:
Insourcia 为您的助手提供直接访问法国公司数据的权限：包含3000万家企业实体，其中1700万家处于运营状态，涵盖3200万项董事职务、700万份已提交的年度财报以及2000万项法律事件。

该连接器涵盖五大功能模块。

发现
通过自然语言搜索行业、地理区域、企业规模、董事信息或财务数据（营收、EBITDA、债务、现金、基金是否出现在股东名单中）
批量匹配CRM导出文件或电子表格与正确的SIREN编号；当识别存在歧义时，工具会拒绝猜测而非返回可能错误的答案。

档案
通过单次调用获取单一公司的基础信息、运营状态、员工数量、董事信息、行业编码，以及定向展示其集团架构：控股关系、子公司、关联公司、共同董事信息。

财务数据
连续财年的利润表、资产负债表及财务比率（现金、净债务、营运资本、利润率、付款条款、股息）
信用风险等级从AAA到D，包含3/6/12个月违约概率及主要影响因素。

法律监控
可搜索所有公司或单个公司的时间线，涵盖企业转让、破产程序、账户备案、增资扩股、公共采购中标、补贴、除名及注册信息。

监控清单
可通过对话保存搜索记录或对特定公司设置监控，随后查看变化内容并标记信号为已处理
这些监控对象与Insourcia网页应用使用的完全一致：助手保存的任何内容均可在您的账户中找到。

数据来源于法国公共登记处（INPI/RNE、INSEE、BODACC、DECP）及行业来源，由我们进行整合和对账。需要Insourcia账户。

payload.name: Mizan

Also screens a whole portfolio, finds halal alternatives, calculates dividend purification and zakat. Every answer carries a 'say' field: one or two plain sentences to read aloud. Research output, not investment advice. Every tool is read-only: no sign-in and nothing about the user is stored. There are no ads or paid placements. Built by Good Turn Studio. payload.longDescription: 根据四项已发布的伊斯兰教法股权标准（AAOIFI、道琼斯伊斯兰市场、标普伊斯兰、MSCI伊斯兰）对在美国上市的公司进行筛选，首先审查其业务范围（各标准排除的禁止行业），然后审查其债务情况，利用实时市场数据和公司自身的SEC文件。还可对整个投资组合进行筛选，寻找符合教法的替代方案，计算股息净化和天课。每个回答都包含一个'say'字段：1-2句简洁的可朗读语句。研究结果，而非投资建议。所有工具均为只读模式：无需登录，且不存储任何用户信息。无广告或付费推广位置。由Good Turn Studio开发。更多信息请访问https://askmizan.com

payload.name: Finality Crypto Tax
payload.description: 核对您的加密货币税务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Finality turns your crypto history into tax figures you can check. Connect your wallets and exchange exports, and Finality reconciles every trade, swap and transfer across chains and venues, matching each sale back to what you paid for it so costs are not lost between wallets. Then just ask ChatGPT: what's my capital gains position for this tax year, what did the reconciliation find and what is each finding worth, what was I still holding at the end of the year. Answers come from your own Finality account, with the figures and the working behind them. When a year is ready, Finality produces the working paper for your return (HMRC's SA108 in the UK, IRS Form 8949 in the US) and an evidence workbook for your records. Connecting is read-only by default; choose Full automation to let ChatGPT add wallets and start scans for you. It can never delete your account, change your sign-in or see exchange passwords.

payload.name: Seaworthy Insurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Seaworthy Insurance estimates what individual disability insurance would cost you, based on your occupation, age, sex, and income. The prices come from more than 400 carrier illustrations Seaworthy ran in 2026 across five disability insurers. Seaworthy Insurance是面向医生、牙医、麻醉护士执业者（CRNAs）、律师、科技专业人员及其他高收入人群的独立残疾保险经纪公司，已在全美50个州取得执业许可。

payload.name: Pappers France
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pappers gives ChatGPT access to French legal and public data from more than a hundred official sources, updated daily.

- Companies: search companies by name or criteria and read their profiles (SIREN, directors, beneficial owners, filings, annual accounts, ownership maps).
- Compliance: screen individuals against politically exposed person (PEP) and international sanctions lists.
- Legal: explore French case law and legislation, and get sourced legal research notes.
- Real estate: query land-registry and property data (parcels, owners, sales, buildings, energy-performance certificates).
- Politics: follow French and EU parliamentary activity (members of parliament, votes, amendments, bills) and local-government documents.

Designed for financial analysis, sales screening, investment and M&A, compliance and due diligence (KYC, KYB, AML), legal research, real estate, local-government monitoring, and public affairs, all from a single connector.

Limitations: coverage is limited to French entities and French and EU public records. A Pappers account is required, and beneficial-owner data requires a legitimate-interest authorization. The plugin only reads data: it cannot file formalities, change registry records, or access private information such as bank accounts. Results are informational and are not legal, financial, or credit advice.
payload.longDescription:
Pappers 为 ChatGPT 提供访问权限，可获取来自100多个官方数据源的法国法律和公共数据，数据每日更新。

- 企业：通过名称或条件搜索企业并查看其档案（SIREN 编号、董事、受益所有人、申报文件、年度财务报表、股权结构图）。
- 合规：将个人与政治敏感人物（PEP）和国际制裁名单进行比对。

- 房地产：查询土地登记和房产数据（地块、业主、交易记录、建筑物、能效证书）。
- 政治：跟踪法国及欧盟议会活动（议员、投票记录、修正案、法案）和地方政府文件。

专为金融分析、销售筛查、投资与并购（M&A）、合规审查（KYC、KYB、AML）、尽职调查、法律研究、房地产分析、地方政府监控和公共事务设计，所有功能通过单一连接器实现。

需要 Pappers 账户，受益所有人数据需提供合法利益授权。

payload.name: Prop Trading Intelligence
payload.description: 自营交易公司规则，附来源
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Prop Trading Intelligence answers questions about prop trading firms' evaluation rules from a hand-checked dataset. Every rule value comes with a quote from the firm's own website, a link to that page and the date it was verified there.

Use it to:
- see which firms and programmes are covered
- find programmes that meet conditions such as news trading allowed, weekend holding, no consistency rule, a drawdown type, a minimum profit split, no time limit or a fee refund
- look up a programme's evaluation fees by account size, in the currency the firm lists
- read one firm's rules: profit targets, daily and maximum drawdown, time limits, minimum trading days, consistency, payouts and more
- get plain definitions of prop trading rules
- calculate a position size from account size, risk and stop loss, or the gain needed to recover from a drawdown

It is for traders researching prop firm evaluations and anyone learning how prop firm rules work. No sign-in is needed.

Limitations: the dataset covers forex and CFD programmes, and firms are added over time. A rule that has not been verified is reported as not yet verified, which means unknown, not absent. Firms can change their rules between checks, so every value shows its verified date and is flagged once a re-check is due. Fees are never converted between currencies. Results are listed alphabetically and are not a ranking or a recommendation. The plugin does not give trading advice, place trades, access trading accounts or sell anything.

The data is Pipster Research (CC BY 4.0), published by Data Vantix Ltd, which trades as Pipster, a prop firm. Pipster's own programmes are included and are checked by the same method as every other firm's.
payload.longDescription:
Prop Trading Intelligence 通过人工核查的数据集，解答关于自营交易公司评估规则的问题。每个规则值都附有该机构官网的引用、该页面链接以及验证日期。

- 查看哪些机构和项目被覆盖

- 阅读某家机构的规则：盈利目标、每日及最大回撤、时间限制、最低交易天数、一致性要求、收益分配等
- 获取自营交易规则的明确定义
- 根据账户规模、风险和止损计算仓位大小，或计算回撤后所需盈利金额

适用于研究自营交易公司评估的交易者以及了解自营交易规则运作机制的人士。
无需登录即可使用。

限制条件：数据集涵盖外汇和差价合约项目，机构会随时间逐步增加。
未验证的规则会标注为「尚未验证」，表示信息未知而非规则缺失。

payload.name: Creddy: Credit Card Rewards

It does not need an account, never asks for card numbers or login details, and cannot apply for cards, move points, or make purchases. payload.name: Trackstone
payload.description: 出租房产：价格与回报率
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find out what your rented property is worth, or find one that already pays rent, without leaving the conversation.

Trackstone is a French real estate agency dedicated to rented properties: the property is sold with its tenant in place, and the lease simply continues with the new owner. The seller does not wait for the tenant to leave, and the buyer collects rent from day one.

What you can do:
- Value your rented apartment or house. Get a price range, the price per square meter and the gross yield your property offers a buyer, calculated from real comparable sales in your area (French public land registry, DVF), with a reliability score from 1 to 5.
- Browse rented properties for sale. Tell ChatGPT your city, your budget and the gross or net yield you are aiming for: Trackstone shows matching listings with photos, price, rent and both yields, sorted by the yield that matters to you.
- Read a city's market at a glance: price per square meter for apartments and houses, how prices have moved year after year, median rent and gross yield.

From any result, one click takes you to Trackstone to open the detailed estimate, view the listing or talk to an advisor about your sale.

Made for owners who want to sell a rented property in France, and for investors who want a property that earns rent from the first month.

Good to know: France only. Estimates cover apartments and houses; they are indicative, not formal appraisals, and less precise where few sales exist. Search results only include properties published publicly on Trackstone. No account is required, and the plugin never makes offers or transactions on your behalf.
payload.longDescription:
无需离开对话界面，即可了解您的出租房产价值，或寻找已产生租金收益的房产。

Trackstone是一家法国房地产中介，专注出租房产交易：房产连同租客一并出售，租赁合同由新业主继续履行。卖方无需等待租客搬离，买方从成交第一天起即可收取租金。

您可以：
- 评估出租公寓或住宅价值
获取价格区间、每平方米价格及买家可获得的毛回报率，该数据基于您所在区域的真实成交案例（法国公共土地登记处DVF数据），并附带1到5分的可靠性评分。
- 浏览待售出租房产
告诉ChatGPT您的城市、预算以及目标毛回报率或净回报率：Trackstone将展示匹配房源，包含照片、价格、租金及两种回报率，按您关注的回报率排序。
- 快速了解城市市场情况：公寓和住宅的每平方米价格、历年价格变化趋势、中位租金及毛回报率。

在任何搜索结果页面，一键跳转至Trackstone查看详细估价、房源信息或联系顾问咨询出售事宜。

专为希望出售法国出租房产的业主，以及希望获得首月即可产生租金收益房产的投资者设计。

重要说明：仅适用于法国。
估价范围包括公寓和住宅；估价结果仅供参考，非正式评估报告，在成交案例较少的区域可能精度较低。

payload.name: Keel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Keel turns your ideas into systematic strategies for Hyperliquid crypto perpetual futures (perps). Connect it to ChatGPT, describe a strategy, and ChatGPT builds it from Keel's strategy components, backtests it on real Hyperliquid history with fees and slippage, and explains the results.

With Keel in ChatGPT you can:
- Build and edit strategies by describing them
- Backtest them and compare runs side by side
- Start from a verified strategy in the Keel library
- Keep notes on strategies and share a result by link
- See how the strategies you run in Keel are doing

Everything you create stays in your Keel workspace. Nothing is public unless you share it.

Keel in ChatGPT is for strategy research and backtesting. It does not place trades, submit orders, move funds or connect wallets — no order executes inside ChatGPT. What it writes is limited to your own Keel workspace: strategy drafts, backtest runs, notes and share links. Running a strategy with real capital is set up and approved by you in the Keel web app, outside ChatGPT. Backtests are simulations on historical data, not predictions or financial advice; trading perpetual futures carries a substantial risk of loss.

Keel measures the strategies you design. It does not give investment advice or recommendations, and backtest results do not predict future returns.
payload.longDescription:
Keel 将您的想法转化为适用于 Hyperliquid 加密货币永续期货（perps）的系统化策略。连接至 ChatGPT，描述策略，ChatGPT 将基于 Keel 的策略组件构建策略，使用手续费和滑点在真实 Hyperliquid 历史数据上进行回测，并解释结果。

在 ChatGPT 中使用 Keel 可实现：
- 通过描述构建和编辑策略
- 进行回测并并排比较不同运行结果
- 从 Keel 库中已验证的策略开始
- 为策略添加备注并通过链接分享结果
- 查看您在 Keel 中运行的策略表现

您创建的所有内容都会保存在个人 Keel 工作区中。
除非您主动分享，否则内容不会公开。

ChatGPT 中的 Keel 仅用于策略研究和回测。
它不会执行交易、提交订单、转移资金或连接钱包——ChatGPT 内部不会执行任何订单。
其生成内容仅限于您的个人 Keel 工作区：策略草案、回测记录、备注和分享链接。
使用真实资金运行策略需在 Keel 网页应用中独立完成，且需您自行设置并确认。
回测基于历史数据模拟，非未来预测或金融建议；交易永续期货存在重大亏损风险。

Keel 会评估您设计的策略。
但不会提供投资建议或推荐，回测结果不预示未来收益。

payload.name: Daffy

Daffy is a donor-advised fund: one account for all your giving. Add cash, stock, or crypto, get your tax deduction when you contribute, invest it to grow tax-free, and give to any of 1.5 million+ US charities whenever you're ready.

payload.name: Wealth Tracker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Wealth Tracker keeps your whole net worth in one place: cash and savings, investments, crypto, property, vehicles and other valuables, minus mortgages, loans and other debts. Connect it to ChatGPT to ask about your money in plain words and keep your records up to date from the conversation.

What you can do:
- See your net worth, totals, allocation and liquidity, how they have moved over time, and the income your holdings earned.
- Find any holding by name, ticker or ISIN, and list everything that is due or out of date for an update.
- Record a balance, a buy or sell you have already made, interest or a fee, or a whole account statement or screenshot at once. Every change can be previewed first, returns a receipt, and can be undone within 30 days.

What it does not do:
- It never moves money, makes payments or places trades. Buys and sells are records of trades you made elsewhere.

- It reads and changes only the signed-in user's own Wealth Tracker records, and sees nothing you have not added to Wealth Tracker.

通过Dinzo插件，ChatGPT可以回答用户关于其Dinzo数据的问题，例如某类支出金额、未结信用卡账单及到期时间，或月底余额情况。在获得用户确认后，ChatGPT可通过读写权限在用户Dinzo账户中创建、编辑、分类和删除记录。

Dinzo从不处理资金：它不执行支付、转账或投资操作，不会查看银行密码，也无法连接银行账户。记录账单支付仅会在用户Dinzo记录中进行标记。

需要现有的Dinzo账户。Dinzo应用和数据使用葡萄牙语；ChatGPT以用户语言进行回答。

information.label: Capabilities

payload.name: akta.pro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
akta.pro provides private company data, news and signals for AI agents like ChatGPT to find and enrich companies, monitor company events, and track developments across industries and market themes.

1. Find companies with filters: Build company lists, market maps, target accounts and peer sets using industry, location, ownership, funding, investors, revenue, valuation and more.
2. Enrich companies and build profiles: Access data on 20M+ companies across 74 structured fields, covering firmographics, management, products, funding, transactions, revenue, valuation, technology and more.
3. Monitor company news, signals and events: Monitor 20M+ companies across 77 event types including funding, M&A, partnerships, product launches, executive changes, hiring, layoffs, litigation and other material activity.
4. Monitor industry and topic news, signals and events: Surface activity and trends across 30,000+ sub-sectors, or any theme, technology or market topic described in plain language, including funding, M&A, product activity, leadership moves and other events.
5. Analyze alternative signals: Track headcount, web traffic, job posts, social posts, employee reviews and product reviews, all linked to the same company ID.

Requires an akta.pro account.
payload.longDescription:
akta.pro为像ChatGPT这样的AI代理提供私营公司数据、新闻和信号，帮助其发现并丰富公司信息，监控公司事件，追踪各行业和市场主题的发展动态。

1. 通过筛选条件查找公司：根据行业、地点、所有权、融资、投资者、营收、估值等维度构建公司列表、市场图谱、目标客户和竞品集合。
2. 丰富公司信息并建立档案：访问覆盖74个结构化字段的2000多万家公司数据，包含企业属性、管理层、产品、融资、交易、营收、估值、技术等信息。
3. 监控公司新闻、信号和事件：跟踪2000多万家公司的77种事件类型，包括融资、并购、合作、产品发布、高管变动、招聘、裁员、诉讼等重大动态。
4. 监控行业和主题新闻、信号和事件：揭示30000多个子行业或任意用自然语言描述的主题、技术或市场领域的活动与趋势，包括融资、并购、产品动态、领导层变动等事件。
5. 分析另类信号：追踪员工规模、网站流量、招聘启事、社交动态、员工评价和产品评价，所有数据均与统一公司ID关联。

需要akta.pro账户。

payload.name: Yield Clarity
payload.description: 你的财务计划在聊天中
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Yield Clarity tracks your investments, cash, pensions, property and spending, and forecasts when you could reach financial independence.

Connect your Yield Clarity account to ask about your plan in ChatGPT:

- Net worth, holdings and planned spending, in your plan's currency
- Your projected financial independence date, retirement outlook and year-by-year forecast
- What-ifs, such as saving more each month, retiring on a different date, a different return or a one-off cost, compared with your current plan. Nothing is saved.
- Monte Carlo simulations: the chance of reaching financial independence by your target date and of your money lasting through retirement
- Portfolio history and the effect of your saved decisions

The connection is read-only: ChatGPT can't add, change or delete anything in your Yield Clarity account. Figures come from Yield Clarity's own calculations, so they match the app. Forecasts are estimates based on your own assumptions, not financial advice.

Requires a Yield Clarity account with AI assistant access. You can disconnect at any time in Yield Clarity under Settings, AI assistants.
payload.longDescription:
Yield Clarity跟踪您的投资、现金、养老金、房产和支出，并预测您可能实现财务自由的时间。

将您的Yield Clarity账户连接至ChatGPT，以询问您的计划：

- 以您计划货币显示的净资产、持仓和支出计划
- 您预计的财务自由日期、退休前景及逐年预测
- 情景模拟，例如每月增加储蓄、更换退休日期、不同收益率或一次性支出成本，与当前计划的对比
不会保存任何数据
- 蒙特卡洛模拟：在目标日期前实现财务自由的可能性，以及资金在退休期间持续性的概率
- 投资组合历史及您保存决策的影响

该连接为只读模式：ChatGPT无法在您的Yield Clarity账户中添加、修改或删除任何内容。
数据来源于Yield Clarity自身的计算，因此与App内数据一致。
预测结果基于您提供的假设条件，仅供参考，不构成财务建议。

需要拥有具备AI助手权限的Yield Clarity账户。
您可在Yield Clarity的「设置」-「AI助手」中随时断开连接。

payload.name: TakeHome Paycheck Calculator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find out what you will actually take home. TakeHome is a paycheck calculator for ChatGPT that turns a US salary or hourly wage into net pay per paycheck, per month and per year for tax year 2026.

Ask things like "what's my take-home pay on $95,000 in Colorado", "how much is $28 an hour after taxes" or "compare $140k in New York City with $120k in Austin". TakeHome shows your paycheck after taxes with a clear breakdown of every deduction, and lets you switch pay frequency, state, filing status and 401(k) right in the chat.

What it calculates:
- Federal income tax with 2026 brackets and standard deductions, the child tax credit, and the new deductions for qualified tips, overtime premium pay and seniors
- Social Security and Medicare, including the wage base cap and the additional Medicare tax
- State income tax for all 50 states and Washington, D.C.
- City and county income taxes such as New York City, Yonkers, Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, Detroit, Columbus, Cleveland, Cincinnati, Kansas City, St. Louis, Louisville, Wilmington, Portland and Multnomah County, and every Maryland county
- State payroll deductions like California SDI, New York and New Jersey disability and paid family leave, and paid leave programs in Washington, Massachusetts, Oregon, Colorado and other states
- Traditional 401(k) and 403(b) contributions, pre-tax health benefits, HSA and FSA, bonuses, hourly overtime and tips
- Weekly, biweekly, semi-monthly and monthly pay schedules, and single, married and head of household filing

Comparing job offers or thinking about moving? The job offer comparison puts 2 to 4 salaries side by side across states and cities and shows how much more you keep with each.

TakeHome needs no account and does not store what you enter. Results are estimates for planning based on published 2026 tax rules, not tax advice. Actual paychecks depend on your W-4 and your employer's withholding.
payload.longDescription:
了解您实际到手的工资数额。
TakeHome 是一款适用于 ChatGPT 的工资计算器，可将美国的年薪或时薪转换为 2026 年度的每笔工资、每月和每年的税后收入。

您可以询问类似「在科罗拉多州 95,000 美元的收入税后能拿多少」「每小时 28 美元税后收入多少」或「比较纽约市 14 万美元与奥斯汀 12 万美元的收入差异」的问题。
TakeHome 会展示您税后的工资明细，清晰列出每一项扣除项，并支持在聊天中直接切换发薪频率、州、申报状态和 401(k) 选项。

计算内容包括：
- 2026 年度联邦所得税，包括税率等级和标准扣除额、儿童税收抵免，以及针对合格小费、加班补贴和老年人的新扣除项
- 社会保障税和医疗保险税，包含工资基数上限和附加医疗保险税
- 所有 50 个州及华盛顿特区的州所得税
- 纽约市、扬克斯、费城、匹兹堡、底特律、哥伦布、克利夫兰、辛辛那提、堪萨斯城、圣路易斯、路易斯维尔、威尔明顿、波特兰和马尔特诺马县等城市和县的所得税，以及所有马里兰州县
- 加州残疾保险（SDI）、纽约和新泽西州的残疾及带薪家庭假、华盛顿、马萨诸塞、俄勒冈、科罗拉多等州的带薪休假计划
- 传统 401(k) 和 403(b) 退休金、税前健康福利、HSA 和 FSA、奖金、时薪加班和小费
- 每周、双周、半月和月结发薪方式，以及单身、已婚和户主申报状态

在比较工作机会或考虑搬家时？
工作机会对比功能可将 2 至 4 个跨州和城市的薪资并列展示，清晰显示每份工作的实际到手收入差异。

TakeHome 无需账户且不会保存您输入的任何信息。
结果仅为基于 2026 年税法规定的估算数据，不构成税务建议。
实际工资取决于您的 W-4 表格和雇主的预扣税款。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Calculate take-home pay after taxes, Compare job offers after taxes

payload.name: Earnings Feed
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Research public SEC records with Earnings Feed. Look up a company by ticker or CIK; list recent filings by filer and form type; find filings by company name or ticker; inspect a filing's metadata and document list; and review disclosed insider transactions. Results include filing accessions and links to SEC sources and Earnings Feed.

Filing search matches filer company names or tickers, not the text inside filings. Filing detail returns metadata and document names, not document text or quoted passages. Ownership filings can have different filers and issuers. Insider acquisition and disposition filters include awards, gifts and other transaction types, not just open-market purchases and sales. Results reflect the records available when requested.

Connect an existing Earnings Feed account through OAuth. Requests use that account's API allowance. This plugin provides research information and does not execute trades, manage subscriptions or create filing alerts.
payload.longDescription:
通过Earnings Feed研究公开的SEC记录。通过股票代码或CIK查找公司；按申报方和文件类型列出最近的文件；通过公司名称或股票代码查找文件；检查文件的元数据和文档列表；查看披露的内部人员交易。结果包含文件接入编号以及到SEC来源和Earnings Feed的链接。

文件搜索仅匹配申报公司名称或股票代码，而非文件内的文本内容。文件详情仅返回元数据和文档名称，而非文档正文或引用内容。所有权文件可能包含不同的申报方和发行人。内部人员买入和卖出过滤器包含奖励、赠与和其他交易类型，而不仅仅是场内买卖。结果反映请求时可用的记录。

通过OAuth连接现有Earnings Feed账户。请求将使用该账户的API配额。此插件提供研究信息，不执行交易、管理订阅或创建文件警报。

payload.name: Kryptos
payload.description: 加密货币组合、税务及账簿
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kryptos brings your crypto portfolio, transaction history, tax figures and accounting ledger into ChatGPT, across 5,000+ exchanges, wallets and blockchains.

Ask what you hold and what it is worth, search your transaction history by asset, wallet, label or date, review DeFi positions and NFT collections, and look at the ledger detail behind any trade.

Kryptos also finds the data problems that make crypto tax wrong — missing prices, missing cost basis, sells with no matching purchase, balances that disagree with the ledger, wallets you never connected — and lets you fix them in the same conversation: recategorise a transaction, correct a price, merge a transfer that detection missed, or add a trade that never made it into an export.

Finance teams can map transactions to a chart of accounts, apply categorisation rules, generate double-entry journals and push them to Xero, QuickBooks or Softledger.

You sign in to Kryptos with OAuth and grant access to one workspace. Kryptos never asks for exchange API keys or wallet private keys in the conversation. It reads and records only — no tool can send, swap, withdraw, deposit or trade any asset.

Requires a Kryptos account.
payload.longDescription:
Kryptos将您的加密货币组合、交易记录、税务数据和会计分录整合到ChatGPT中，覆盖5000多个交易所、钱包和区块链。

您可以询问自己持有哪些资产及其价值，按资产、钱包、标签或日期搜索交易记录，查看DeFi持仓和NFT收藏，查阅任何交易背后的分录明细。

Kryptos还能发现导致加密货币税务错误的数据问题——缺失的价格、缺失的成本基础、无对应买入记录的卖出、与分录不一致的余额、未连接的钱包——并在同一对话中允许您进行修正：重新分类交易、更正价格、合并检测遗漏的转账，或添加未导出的交易。

财务团队可将交易映射到会计科目表，应用分类规则，生成复式记账凭证并推送到Xero、QuickBooks或Softledger。

您可通过OAuth登录Kryptos并授权一个工作区访问权限。
Kryptos在对话中从不请求交易所API密钥或钱包私钥。
它仅执行读取和记录操作——任何工具都无法发送、交换、提现、存款或交易任何资产。

需要Kryptos账户。

information.label: Capabilities

payload.name: Jemma
payload.description: 护士薪资与实际到手收入计算
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Jemma answers nurse pay questions with real math. Ask what you'll take home at your hourly rate, what a travel contract is worth after tax, whether a 1099 or locums rate beats a staff job, what you'd need to earn to move cities, or what nurses with your credential earn in your state. Every figure comes from Jemma's calculators, using 2026 federal and state tax tables, and pay benchmarks come from the Bureau of Labor Statistics, always labeled. Where enough nurses have verified their pay on Jemma, you see Jemma's median too, and where they haven't, you see how close that group is to the 30 nurses Jemma needs to publish it. No account needed, and Jemma never asks for your license number or your salary inside ChatGPT. Estimates, not tax advice.
payload.longDescription: Jemma通过真实数学计算解答护士薪资问题。您可询问在时薪下实际到手收入、外派合同税后价值、1099模式或临时护士费率是否优于正式岗位、换城市工作需达到的收入水平，以及与您资质相符的护士在本州的平均薪资。所有数据均来自Jemma的计算器，采用2026年联邦及各州税务表格，薪资基准数据来自美国劳工统计局（BLS），且均会标注来源。当足够多护士在Jemma上验证过薪资数据时，您将看到Jemma的中位数统计；若数据不足，则会显示该群体与Jemma要求的30名护士样本的接近程度。无需账户即可使用，Jemma在ChatGPT内不会索取您的执照号码或薪资信息。以上内容为估算结果，不构成税务建议。

收据处理功能利用AI自动标记可能符合HSA/FSA资格的支出，并为您的审核建议税务分类。

总金额按货币类型分开显示。

请勿为不支持的请求提供计划文件或支付凭证。

payload.name: PayFresco Payment Planner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PayFresco Payment Planner helps a merchant compare a registration country, customer markets, billing model, presentment currencies, settlement currencies, and payment methods with a catalog of PayFresco capabilities. It separates documented, conditional, unsupported, and unknown requirements. It builds a preparation checklist for policies, refunds, fulfillment, billing disclosures, currency handling, and authentication questions, and it keeps the United Kingdom, the European Union, and the EEA distinct. It builds a settlement route table and calculates a converted amount only when the user supplies the amount and the rate.

Approved coverage is conditional on underwriting and setup. It is not merchant approval. Entities outside comprehensively sanctioned jurisdictions may apply, and no US SSN or ITIN is needed to apply. This app never collects those numbers. Customer markets can be any non-sanctioned country, with the United Kingdom, the European Union, and the EEA kept distinct. Presentment currencies, settlement currencies, routes, and payment methods follow that approved catalog, including EUR to USD and GBP to USD, with conversion only when the currencies differ. Fees, reserves, and payout timing stay unknown. The app does not approve a merchant, move money, submit an application, or contact anyone. It does not store what you type. Do not enter card numbers, government IDs, or bank details. Some product categories are outside what this ChatGPT app will plan. Results are planning information, not legal or underwriting advice. OpenAI has not endorsed this app.
payload.longDescription:
PayFresco Payment Planner帮助商家对比注册国家、客户市场、计费模式、展示货币、结算货币和支付方式与PayFresco功能目录。它会区分已记录的、有条件支持的、不支持的和未知的要求。它会生成政策、退款、履行、账单披露、货币处理和身份验证问题的准备清单，并单独区分英国、欧盟和欧洲经济区。它会生成结算路径表，并仅在用户输入金额和汇率时计算转换金额。

批准的覆盖范围取决于承保和设置。这不代表商家批准。全面受制裁司法管辖区以外的实体可以申请，申请时无需提供美国社会安全号码或ITIN。该应用永远不会收集这些号码。客户市场可以是任何非受制裁国家，英国、欧盟和欧洲经济区将单独区分。展示货币、结算货币、路径和支付方式遵循该批准目录，包括欧元兑美元和英镑兑美元，仅在货币不同时进行转换。费用、保证金和付款时间未知。该应用不批准商家、不转移资金、不提交申请或联系任何人。它不存储您输入的内容。请勿输入卡号、政府身份证件或银行信息。某些产品类别超出此ChatGPT应用的规划范围。结果仅为规划信息，不是法律或承保建议。OpenAI未认可此应用。

payload.name: MoveSurge
payload.description: 揭示市场波动及其原因
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MoveSurge is a real-time market news tape for US equities and cross-asset macro that measures what each event did to the price. For eligible headlines it records the instrument price immediately before the headline was published, one minute after and ten minutes after, plus volume against its usual level for that window, so each move is tied to the event that caused it.

With this plugin you can:
- Ask why something suddenly moved. MoveSurge detects abnormal moves in oil, index futures, currencies and stocks, investigates them, and publishes the cause it found with the evidence, a confidence level and how the move followed through.
- Check earnings: EPS and revenue against the consensus estimate, beat or miss, guidance direction and the stock's measured reaction to the release, plus who reports next.
- Check economic data: CPI, payrolls, PMIs and central-bank decisions with actual, forecast and previous, the surprise, and what markets did in the minutes after the print, plus the releases scheduled ahead.
- Follow President Trump's Truth Social posts as they cross the tape, with the measured reaction where a post moved an instrument.

payload.name: QuarterWise 1099 Tax Planner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A self employment tax calculator and quarterly estimated tax planner for 2026. Tell QuarterWise 1099 Tax Planner your 1099 or freelance income, business expenses, and filing status, and it works through the IRS 2026 Form 1040-ES worksheets: self-employment tax on 92.35% of net profit (12.4% Social Security up to the 184,500 dollar wage base, 2.9% Medicare, and the 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax), the deductible half of SE tax, the 20% qualified business income (QBI) deduction, and federal income tax with the 2026 brackets and standard deduction.

It answers questions like "I made 60k on 1099, how much do I owe", "how much should I pay in quarterly taxes", and "how much to set aside for taxes as a freelancer". It handles a W-2 job plus a side gig (wages use up the Social Security wage base and paycheck withholding is subtracted), married couples where one or both spouses are self-employed, business losses, the child tax credit, and the new 2026 senior and charitable deductions.

For quarterly estimated taxes it compares 90% of your 2026 tax with 100% of your 2025 tax (110% if your 2025 AGI was over 150,000 dollars), applies the 1,000 dollar rule, and gives the amount for each due date: Apr 15, Jun 15, Sep 15, 2026 and Jan 15, 2027. Missed a payment? Add what you have paid and it shows what to pay now and at each remaining date.

The result appears as a card in the chat: a waterfall from income through deductions to tax, and four quarterly payment cards with dates, amounts, and status. Download a calendar file (.ics) with reminders before each due date and a printable PDF worksheet laid out like the IRS worksheet, with a payment record.

Good for freelancers, independent contractors, gig workers (DoorDash, Uber, Instacart, Etsy), consultants, and anyone with 1099-NEC or 1099-K income.

Limitations: estimates for planning only, not tax advice. Federal tax for tax year 2026 only; state income tax is not calculated (it tells you if your state has none). Capital gains rates, AMT, net investment income tax, the earned income credit, penalty amounts, and the annualized installment method are not included. Above the 2026 QBI threshold it applies the phase-in using W-2 wages your business paid, with property basis treated as zero. It does not file returns or make payments.

它可以解答诸如「我在1099收入中赚了6万美元，需要缴纳多少税？」、「季度税款应缴纳多少？」以及「作为自由职业者应预留多少税款？」等问题。支持处理包含W-2工作和副业的情况（工资会消耗社会保障工资基数且工资税扣除会减少），夫妻共同申报中一方或双方为自雇人士的情况，业务亏损，儿童税收抵免，以及2026年新的老年和慈善扣除额。

在计算季度预估税款时，它会比较2026年税款的90%与2025年税款的100%（若2025年应税收入超过150,000美元则为110%），应用1,000美元规则，并给出每个缴税日期的金额：2026年4月15日、6月15日、9月15日以及2027年1月15日。错过付款？输入已支付金额，它会显示当前需支付金额及剩余日期的应缴金额。

结果将以聊天界面中的卡片形式呈现：从收入经过扣除项到税款的瀑布流视图，以及包含日期、金额和状态的四张季度付款卡片。可下载包含每个缴税日期提醒的日历文件（.ics格式）和可打印的PDF表格（布局与IRS表格相同，并附有付款记录）。

适用于自由职业者、独立承包商、零工工作者（DoorDash、Uber、Instacart、Etsy）、顾问，以及所有拥有1099-NEC或1099-K收入的人士。

限制条件：仅用于规划估算，不构成税务建议。仅计算2026年度联邦税，不包含州所得税（会提示您的州是否无州所得税）。不包含资本利得税率、替代最低税（AMT）、净投资收入税、工薪抵税额、罚款金额以及年度分摊支付法。超过2026年QBI门槛时，将使用企业支付的W-2工资进行逐步调整，资产基础视为零。不处理税务申报或实际缴款。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PocketBuddy answers questions about your spending, budgets and net worth with your own numbers instead of averages.

Ask why you spent more this month than last, what you pay for every month, how your net worth has changed, or how your budgets and goals are doing. PocketBuddy works it out from your accounts and shows it beside the conversation. Every answer says which dates it covers, how many accounts it includes, how recently they updated, and what it left out, such as moves between your own accounts.

You can look around before connecting anything. A sample household shows what an answer looks like, and two calculators work from numbers you type in: how much you would need to stop working at a given spending level, and how your retirement savings compare for your age.

PocketBuddy reads; it does not act. It cannot move money, pay a bill, trade, or change a bank connection. If you choose to allow changes when you connect, it can recategorize a transaction or add one you paid in cash. Each change is shown first, happens only after you approve it, and can be undone.

PocketBuddy gives you numbers, not financial advice. A purchase check shows what your month looks like with the purchase in it and leaves the decision to you.

When you connect, PocketBuddy returns the balances, totals and transactions needed for your question, including merchant names. Its account tool can also return your account ID, name and email. It never returns bank logins, account numbers or access tokens. You can disconnect at any time in PocketBuddy's settings.
payload.longDescription:
PocketBuddy会根据您的实际数据而非平均值回答关于消费、预算和净资产的问题。

您可以询问为什么本月消费比上个月多，每月支付的固定费用，净资产的变化情况，或预算和目标的完成状况。
PocketBuddy会从您的账户中分析并显示结果，紧随对话之后。
每个回答都会注明覆盖的日期范围、包含的账户数量、更新时间以及未包含的内容，例如账户间的资金划转。

在连接任何账户前您可以先进行浏览。
示例家庭账户展示了一个回答的样式，同时两个计算器可基于您输入的数字运行：在特定消费水平下您需要积累多少资金才能停止工作，以及您的退休储蓄与同龄人相比如何。

PocketBuddy仅用于数据读取，不会执行操作。
它无法转移资金、支付账单、进行交易或修改银行连接。
如果您在连接时选择允许更改，它可以重新分类交易或添加您现金支付的交易记录。
每次修改都会先展示给您确认，仅在获得批准后执行，并且可以撤销。

PocketBuddy仅提供数据，不提供财务建议。
购买检查功能会展示包含该笔消费的月份情况，最终决策仍由您自行做出。

连接后，PocketBuddy会返回回答问题所需的资金余额、总金额和交易记录，包括商户名称。
其账户工具还可返回您的账户ID、名称和邮箱。
它从不返回银行登录信息、账户号码或访问令牌。
您可以在PocketBuddy的设置中随时断开连接。

payload.name: Caliber
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Analyze your Caliber workouts, nutrition, body stats, personal records, and training plans directly from ChatGPT. Chart your progress, visualize trends, and get clear summaries of your fitness data.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中分析 Caliber 记录的训练、营养、身体指标、个人纪录和训练计划。绘制进度图表、查看趋势，并获取清晰的健身数据摘要。

payload.name: Peloton
payload.description: 探索 Peloton 训练课程
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Peloton app in ChatGPT lets you discover classes, explore instructors, and build personalized training plans in seconds. Ask for curated workouts across cycling, strength, yoga, running, meditation, and more—filtered by time, difficulty, and goals. Browse as a guest or connect your Peloton account to save classes and full training plans directly to your schedule. Built for every level, from first-time movers to goal-driven training.
payload.longDescription: ChatGPT 中的 Peloton 应用可让您发现课程、了解教练，并在几秒内制定个性化训练计划。您可以按时长、难度和目标筛选骑行、力量训练、瑜伽、跑步、冥想等精选锻炼。可以访客身份浏览，也可以连接 Peloton 账户，将课程和完整训练计划直接保存到日程中。适合各种水平，从首次开始运动的人到有明确目标的训练者。

payload.name: ChefPlan
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ChefPlan calculates your daily energy needs (BMR, TDEE, and macros) using the Mifflin-St Jeor equation and helps you find recipes with photos, ingredients, and step-by-step instructions. Enter your weight, height, age, gender, activity level, and goal to get a personalized calorie target. Search for recipes by name or get a random dish — all inside the chat.
payload.longDescription: ChefPlan 使用 Mifflin-St Jeor 方程计算你的每日能量需求（BMR、TDEE 和宏量营养素），并帮助你查找附有照片、食材和分步说明的食谱。输入体重、身高、年龄、性别、活动水平和目标，即可获得个性化卡路里目标。你可以按名称搜索食谱，也可以获取一道随机菜品——全部在聊天中完成。

payload.name: SnapCal
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SnapCal makes tracking your nutrition effortless. Simply describe what you eat in natural language and photos, and the AI will instantly estimate your calories and macronutrients (protein, carbs, and fats). View daily summaries, track your weight, and manage your diet with an interactive dashboard directlyinside ChatGPT.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Log meals with calories and macros, Daily calorie and macro summary, Weekly meal history, Edit and delete meals, Personalized calorie and macro goals, Weight tracking and progress

payload.name: BurnFat – Calorie Tracker
payload.description: 规划卡路里与宏量营养素
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: BurnFat helps adults estimate daily calories and macros for fat loss, compare three safety-capped paces, and view an adaptive goal timeline through an interactive planner.
payload.longDescription: BurnFat 帮助成年人估算减脂所需的每日卡路里和宏量营养素，对比三种设有安全上限的减脂速度，并通过交互式规划器查看可调整的目标时间线。
